key_reasoning.reason: Authorization fix: workspace archive and by-conversation reads are now gated on Ability(user).can(Action.READ, conversation) via ensure_conversation_readable in workspace_archive.py. The Ability/Action pattern already exists, but the gate is security-sensitive, must fail like a missing workspace to avoid leaking existence, and needed a fix-up (Conversation.find_owner_ref, a column-only owner lookup) to avoid loading full conversation history on every read. Several test files were also touched to cover denial and reserved-path behaviour.
7 files changed in total: 3 source files (conversation.py model, agent_workspace_service.py, workspace_archive.py) and 4 test files, across src/ and tests/ in 3-4 directories.
